name: Hozue Food Festival
description: Hozue Food Festival is a refined, documentary-styled block theme for regional food and wine weekends, maker gatherings and seasonal riverbank events. The home page is one long early-bird ticket page: an olive header strip, a framed photo window that cross-fades three moments with the title set below it, a floating card-row of quick links ending in one ticket call, a rounded panel feed of programme cells, a price table, a parallax riverbank band, the people, the way in and one repeated call. Fraunces and Work Sans, high-key photography, quiet scroll effects.
